displayAddress: Carmen Beckford Street, Bristol, Somerset, BS1
description:
*** HUGE BALCONY *** TWO JULIETTE BALCONIES *** ECO ROOF *** Light and spacious two double bedroom, two-bathroom penthouse in Stokes Croft, offered fully furnished and available from the 1st of October 2026.

The apartment is in a fantastic location in the heart of Stokes Croft and offers great access to both central Bristol and Gloucester Road. It’s surrounded by amenities as well as being a short walk from Montpelier Park.

KEY FEATURES:
- Large Balcony
- Eco roof 
- Modern finish 
- Two double bedrooms
- Two bathrooms including one ensuite
- Juliette balcony in the living space and bedroom
- White goods included
- Storage space
- Sought after central location
- Short walk to the city centre 
- Surrounded by amenities
- Five minutes walk from Gloucester Road
- Great public transport links

The accommodation comprises: an open plan kitchen/living/dining room on the corner of the building, a master bedroom with an ensuite shower room, a second double bedroom with a Juliette balcony, a master bathroom with a bath over the shower. And a huge balcony giving you 180 degrees views of the city.

The property also benefits from: a fridge/freezer, a washing machine, gas central heating and double glazing.

THINGS TO NOTE:
- Applicants must earn at least two and a half times the rent in order to qualify to let this property
- Smoking is not permitted in this property
